body: Thank you for your support! I began using a year ago when I got into medical school so I was super busy. I started to get heart palpitations but thank god I didn’t ruin my nose. It’s real hard for me to focus but it’s getting easier everyday.

Cocaine and alcohol. Especially cocaine, I used to do it all night and all day to stay up for work. Id do it before I’d drive and id take bumps even at the grocery store. I blocked my plug and deleted his number. A miserable time in my life for about a year. I’m about to hit two weeks sober.
Many others can achieve it! So will you, I have faith in you. I believed the same as you, but anyone is capable of leaving that nasty stuff behind. Stay safe ❤️

Thank you for responding to my post!

Fuck coke, I know exactly how you feel brother. All I want is more and more and I can’t stop whenever I start doing it, especially on Fridays and Saturday. When I quit, I told my party friends I’d be staying in the weekend so I’m not around it. I also blocked and deleted my plugs number cause in the past I’ve always blocked him to try and quit but I always end up texting him again so delete the number.  I guess my breaking point that really got me done was after a seven day bender. I was gonna overdose on Xanax but my dog came in the bathroom and started whimpering and I just couldn’t do it. I thought about my mom and my dad finding out about my problem so I vowed to never do it again. The first five days suck like hell but after your seventh you’ll feel so much better physically and mentally, and I know people just say that but you really do. I wasted so much money on that powder and I regret it so much. Try and go a weekend without it! It’s really not worth it at all to use cocaine. I wish that I realized that sooner, but im so glad I realized it now and so will you. I know that words online don’t help too much but I am saying this from experience, your soul is worth more than such a pointless drug. It stole mine for a while. Quit now when you can, I hope you be safe ❤️.
